subject: an original mint art-deco hotel facade with rounded balconies
art_direction: 薄荷色旅馆立面以圆角阳台与深绿窗框重复，细金线和暖阴影形成清楚节奏。
visible_description: 薄荷色旅馆立面以圆角阳台与深绿窗框重复，细金线和暖阴影形成清楚节奏。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create an original mint art-deco hotel facade with rounded balconies. Crop the facade along the lower sides while keeping the roofline beneath a quiet upper sky area. Each balcony has a slightly different shadow, avoiding mechanical repetition. Use gold trim sparingly at corners and door frames. No hotel name, room numbers, or people appear; the rhythm of curves and recesses carries the scene. Use architectural gouache illustration. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
